errors.evidence: The word 'significant' is a subjective interpretation of the data's magnitude and is not explicitly stated in the figure.
For the 'w/o Augmentation' variant, the Recall value (blue line) is 62.63%, not 64.06%. The value 64.06% corresponds to the Precision for the 'w/o Attention' variant.

errors.text_span: The 'w/o Attention' variant shows a drop in all metrics
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect. For the 'w/o Attention' variant, Precision increases from 62.22% (at 'w/o Augmentation') to 64.06%. It does not drop.

errors.text_span: The 'w/o Prompt & Augmentation' variant shows the lowest scores
errors.evidence: This is an over-generalization. While this variant does show the lowest scores for Recall (56.82%) and F1-score (57.74%), it does not have the lowest Precision. The lowest Precision score (61.06%) occurs with the 'w/o Prompt' variant.
